name: Miko-san Da-isuki!
source: Protagonist was killed by a female shinigami, but it was a mistake. To fix this she took him to three miko sisters, whom can revive him. But the reviving ceremony went wrong too, and protagonist's sexual desire became very high... Sisters took it upon themselves to cure him... by serving him every night...
translation: 主角被女性死神杀死，但这是一个错误。为了解决这个问题，她把他带到了三个巫女姐妹那里，她们可以救活他。但复活仪式也出了问题，主角的性欲变得非常高……姐妹们亲自为他治病……每天晚上服侍他……
